meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以搜索你之前所有对话中保存的记忆，找到过去讨论过的问题、解决方案或工作记录。它会先列出摘要，让你挑选后再查看完整内容。
howto.when: 当你问起之前对话中是否解决过某个问题、上次怎么做的，或者需要回顾之前的工作时触发。

say.text: 我们之前解决过这个bug吗？
say.note: Claude 会搜索相关记忆并给出摘要。

say.text: 上次怎么修复的认证问题？
say.note: Claude 会查找相关记录并展示上下文。

say.text: 帮我查一下上周的决策记录。
say.note: Claude 会按时间范围搜索并列出结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search your persistent memory across all past sessions to find previously discussed problems, solutions, or work records. It first shows a summary for you to pick, then fetches full details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, such as whether a problem was solved before, how something was done last time, or need to review past work.

say_en.text: Did we already fix this bug?
say_en.note: Claude will search memory and show a summary.

say_en.text: How did we fix the auth issue last time?
say_en.note: Claude will find relevant records and show context.

say_en.text: Show me the decisions from last week.
say_en.note: Claude will search by date range and list results.
